primary_claim: Exemplar Partitioning (EP) — a gradient-free, single-hyperparameter Voronoi partition of activation space built via streaming leader-clustering, with no reconstruction/sparsity loss or backward passes — reaches 0.881 mean AUROC across 500 AxBench concepts on Gemma-2-2B-it layer 20 (within 0.03 of the strongest SAE baseline, SAE-A's 0.911, and +0.126 over the canonical GemmaScope SAE) while using about 1,000x less build compute (3.6x10^6 activation tokens and no gradient descent vs. ~4x10^9 tokens and ~10^6 optimizer steps for GemmaScope).

effect.metric: mean AUROC on AxBench latent concept detection (500 concepts)
effect.value: EP at p1: 0.881 AUROC vs. canonical GemmaScope SAE 0.755 (+0.126) and SAE-A 0.911 (within 0.030), at ~1000x less build compute

contradicts_or_qualifies: the assumption that dictionary-learning/SAE machinery (reconstruction + sparsity loss, learned decoder directions) is necessary for finding interpretable, causally-relevant structure in activation space
stated_future_work: test other distance metrics vs. centred cosine distance as a test of the linear representation hypothesis
address seed sensitivity of which activation becomes a region's exemplar (e.g. via running-mean replacement or post-hoc reselection)
characterize what makes the shared EP/SAE core special and how robust it is to seeds
explore steering and patching with EP dictionaries in more depth
track partition diffing across layers, models, and finetuning checkpoints
build refusal/jailbreak/persona/deception diagnostic dictionaries for monitoring
use nearest-exemplar distance as an OOD monitoring signal at deployment
validate EP on more models and datasets beyond Gemma-2-2B and the Pile
limitations_stated: the exemplar direction for refusal is causally necessary but not sufficient on its own — pushing it produces structurally degenerate refusals rather than coherent ones, unlike Arditi et al.'s dedicated refusal direction
EP is sensitive to streaming order, which determines which activation becomes a region's exemplar
only tested on Gemma-2-2B and the Pile so far
there is only a small shared core between EP regions and SAE features; a lot of disagreement exists on both sides depending on resolution
quote: on the AxBench latent concept-detection benchmark at Gemma-2-2B-it layer 20, EP at p₁ reaches 0.881 mean AUROC across all 500 concepts. That's within 0.03 of SAE-A – AxBench's strongest dictionary-based baseline – with about 1,000× less build compute.
